title: Sugoventure: Dragon Master Silk Gaiden
native_title: すごべんちゃー ～ドラゴン・マスター・シルク外伝～
overview:
A romance sugoroku adventure

Five characters, each with a strong personality. Which girl will you fall in love with!?

A 3D sugoroku board game starring characters from Dragon Master Silk. As the hero, you team up with a partner - Aka, Ao, Ki, Ruri or Shirafuji Mizuki - and roll the dice across the board in search of cards hidden in treasure chests, with the final goal of defeating the Demon King. The bond between the two of you is your real weapon, so talk with her in ways that suit her personality and land on date squares to grow closer.

Landing on certain squares raises your stats, which makes the final battle easier. Win the battles along the way, take down bosses yourself, and play cards at the right moment to get ahead of your rivals.

- Three stages, with a hidden character unlocked after the last one
- Up to five players with the Multi Terminal 6

恋愛すごろくアドベンチャー

個性派揃いの5人のキャラクター
キミはどの娘と恋をする!?
